title: Extensions
steps: ⌘⇧P, Show extensions. Every extension is listed from its manifest (extension.json): the built-ins (Open by name, Command list, Vim, Live preview, History, Todos, Calendar, Contacts, Uploads) and, once you install it from the Catalog at the bottom, Word count, a workspace extension. Each shows its version, what it adds (commands, keybindings, menus, views, settings) and what it may ask for, with why.
History says "On, starts when used": its code hasn't run yet. ⌘⇧P lists Show history of this note all the same. Run it: History starts, the view shows, and it now says On.

Open settings (⌘,): History, Todos and Calendar each have a section of their own. Set Calendar's Days to 3 and Show calendar: three days. Turn off Todos' Chips: due dates and repeats show as text at once.
In the Extensions view, press Settings on History: the settings editor opens at its section.

Customize Command list: its files are copied to `.common-ink/extensions/command-list/` and its code opens. Change `label: c.title,` to ``label: `▸ ${c.title}`,``. The status bar says `Extension changes apply after reload · Reload`. Reload, then ⌘⇧P: each command starts with ▸. Revert to built-in deletes the copy (history shows it as Deleted, and Undo brings it back).
Install Word count from the Catalog and reload. Its files are `.common-ink/extensions/word-count/extension.json` and `index.js`. Show word count: the view counts the note on show.

Break Word count: add `throw new Error("oops")` as the first line of `activate` and reload, then Show word count. The Extensions view says it failed, with the error; everything else works. `?safe=1` starts only the built-ins.

Turn History off with its checkbox: it writes `extensions.disabled` to workspace settings, as a change by you. Reload: the history commands and view are gone, and the tab menu has no Add Label. Turn it back on.
